profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and MBA graduate with over a decade of experience building and maintaining large-scale financial enterprise systems.
I am a Java/backend specialist who transitioned from traditional monoliths to modern microservices over the last 5 years.
While some prioritize rapid prototyping, my strength lies in thoroughness, long-term focus, and architectural sustainability. I am a well-rounded engineer who values deep problem-solving and building software that stands the test of time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Outsorced to Itaú Unibanco to maintain and optimize critical financial systems, including Open Finance, customer registration, and identity management platforms.
In this role, I served as the technical lead for the consultancy cohort while remaining hands-on with the architecture. My primary stack centered around Java, Spring Boot, and Python deployed on AWS (ECS). A major highlight of my tenure was auditing a misconfigured autoscaling policy; by fixing this bug, I successfully reduced the cloud infrastructure required for a core project from 256 large instances to only 4, vastly improving system efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Spring Batch · Spring Integration · Engenharia web · Java · PostgreSQL · Spring Webflux · Indústria de software · Spring Framework · Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · Spring Data · Spring Security · Spring MVC · SQL · Design de software · Desenvolvimento de software · Microservices · MySQL · Spring Cloud · MongoDB

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineered and supported a full-stack ERP platform tailored for the physical security sector, with a heavy emphasis on distributed edge processing and hardware integrations. In this role, I maintained full-stack ownership of the platform, building user interfaces in React while managing scalable back-end architectures using Java and Spring Boot. I frequently worked within EDGE environments, developing custom failover mechanisms to guarantee continuous uptime and system reliability under unstable network conditions. Additionally, I managed the application infrastructure using Docker containers deployed within the AWS cloud ecosystem, utilizing PostgreSQL for robust data storage.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Engenharia web · React.js · Indústria de software · Spring Framework · Amazon Web Services · Design de software

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description: Maintained and optimized EPREV, a large-scale enterprise web system designed for storing and processing complex public employee pension data for the state of Pará. Developed on a foundation of Java (Spring Framework) and Oracle Database, I successfully automated the platform's delivery pipeline utilizing Docker containerization. A key achievement of my tenure was designing and evolving Atenta Cloud, a microservices-based architecture created to modularize the monolithic EPREV system using clean code principles and structured design patterns on IBM Power servers. Additionally, I took full ownership of supporting desktop applications, engineering custom Java installers deployed directly onto client machines.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Java · Software de internet · Indústria de software · Spring Framework · Design de software

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Designed the architecture for a healthcare platform, focusing on security and ease of development. Utilized Docker Swarm, Java, PostgreSQL, and Angular 4 as reference technologies to guide and provide examples for the development team. These technologies were used primarily in a demonstrative and advisory capacity.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description: Maintained and enhanced Cefis, a large-scale web platform offering courses focused on accounting. Developed using PHP (Laravel).

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced DIFACT, a large-scale ERP system focused on factoring operations, developed using GeneXus.
Maintained and enhanced DICOB, a large-scale ERP system focused on debt collection, also developed using GeneXus.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Software development using Visual Basic 6, including prototyping. Provided technical support and user training for the software. Also responsible for general computer support and troubleshooting.
